name: Kin'iro no Corda 2 Encore
original_name: 金色のコルダ2 アンコール
source:
Kin'iro no Corda 2Encore is the continuation of 2. After participating in numerous performances, Kahoko is maturing into a wonderful violinist. Instead of solo performances and small group assembles, she is to lead an orchestra as a concert mistress this time.
Besides managing her musical career, as graduation draws nearer and nearer, she has to gather her acts and go after the man of her dreams. After all, some of them are entering university and others may be going overseas, if she doesn't do anything now, she would have no more chances.
Aside from the full cast from the previous installment, Kira the school director became a date-able character. Find out the mystery behind this intriguing character. 

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-15-corda+encore-70-3fdj-43-99.html]PlayAsia[/url]]
translation:
《金色琴弦2安可》是《金色琴弦2》的续作。经历多次演出后，香穗子正逐渐成长为一名出色的小提琴手。这一次，她不再参加独奏或小型合奏，而是要以首席小提琴手的身份带领一支管弦乐团。
除了经营自己的音乐生涯，随着毕业日益临近，她还必须振作起来，主动追求梦中的那个人。毕竟，有些人即将升入大学，另一些人则可能远赴海外；如果现在不采取行动，她或许再也没有机会了。
除前作全体角色外，学校理事吉罗也成为了可攻略角色。去揭开这位神秘人物背后的谜团吧。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-15-corda+encore-70-3fdj-43-99.html]PlayAsia[/url]]
